summary: Round-3 confirm. All four open round-2 items (multi-org pick, percent Double->Int truncation, inline degenerate-body fixtures, observable backoff) are now present and behaviorally specified in the Testing Strategy. No remaining HIGH/MED gaps. Coverage maps cleanly to all decisions, US requirements, and acceptance criteria. Adequate for size M. One residual LOW note (Decision 6 log-secrecy has no behavioral test, delegated to Task 8 security audit) is non-blocking.

round2_items_verified.item: Multi-org pick: two-org fixture variant asserting active/first uuid chosen + cached
round2_items_verified.note: Now an explicit unit-test line: '/organizations returns multiple orgs (add a two-org fixture variant; assert the active/first is chosen and cached).' Fixture variant + selection rule + caching all specified. RESOLVED.

Explicit line: 'percent rounding: Double -> Int for ClaudeUsage truncates as expected for fractional values (e.g. 2.9 -> 2), matching existing QuotaParser behavior.' Conversion is now pinned to truncation with a concrete example. RESOLVED.

round2_items_verified.item: Degenerate bodies pinned as small inline string fixtures
round2_items_verified.location: tech-spec.md:278-281 (Testing Strategy > Unit tests, HTTP classification)
round2_items_verified.note: Explicit line: 'The degenerate bodies (Cloudflare "Just a moment..." HTML, login-page HTML, garbage JSON) are pinned as small inline string fixtures in the test so classification is deterministic.' All three negative bodies + inline source + determinism stated. RESOLVED.

round2_items_verified.item: Backoff asserts an observable, cleared on wake/window-open
round2_items_verified.note: Explicit line: 'assert an observable (WebView never instantiated / fallback-invocation counter stays 0 across N ticks while logged-out), then a wake/window-open event clears the flag and re-probes.' End-state observable, not a spy-on-call. RESOLVED.

findings.location: Section: Testing Strategy / Decision 6 (secrets never logged)
findings.issue: Decision 6 plus an acceptance criterion require that no cookie value or request header is ever written to logs, but the Testing Strategy has no behavioral test for it; the concern is delegated entirely to the security audit (Task 8). This is a defensible allocation for size M, but a one-time audit pass is weaker than a permanent regression guard.
findings.recommendation: Optional, non-blocking: add a unit test that injects sentinel sessionKey/cf_clearance values, drives a fetch + Set-Cookie write-back + a .decodeFailed repro dump through a captured AppLog sink, and asserts the captured output contains neither the sentinel values nor a 'Cookie:' header substring.
